scope: standard 14641 quadratic Koszul AS-regular indexed Z-algebras; index-preserving isomorphism

invariant.name: rho
invariant.definition: Rank of the 02|13 flattening of the canonical top Frobenius tensor

branches.coverage: disjoint exhaustive split proved in prop:opposite-rank-split
branches.witness_partition: Any invertible negative witness: polynomial indexed class. Two invertible positive pairs sharing a position: symmetric CI chart. Residual: no negative and at most one positive partner per position. These predicates exhaust AS objects but do not give a complete residual classification.
branches.growth_obstruction: All marked 20x120 matrices have rank >=19 on P3. No nonzero pure tensor in a cubic overlap; thm:no-consecutive-pure-relations.

branches.relative_geometry: closed in the finite Frobenius tensor candidate locus
branches.known_subcase: Quantum polynomial members have rho=6 and exactly two indexed classes, represented by q_ab=1 and q_ab=-1; prop:quantum-opposite-rank
branches.coverage: symmetrizability existence predicate and its negation; cor:symmetric-rank-six

branches.relative_geometry: open in the finite Frobenius tensor candidate locus
branches.nonempty_witness: quantum polynomial sample rho=12; signed seven/nine samples rho=8
branches.necessary_witness_restrictions: No invertible negative witness at any position; at most one invertibly positive partner per position. One negative witness already recognizes the polynomial indexed class; cor:one-negative-frobenius-recognition.
branches.adjacent_witness_restriction: No invertible adjacent witness of either sign. A positive opposite witness requires rho<=10; rho>=11 has no invertible witnesses at all.

branches.predicate: canonical tensor orbit meets Sym^4 V under an identification of all four spaces
branches.parameter_chart: U in Gr(4,Sym^2 V*): four quadrics have no common projective zero
branches.coverage: chart surjects onto this predicate locus
branches.complete_isomorphism: proved for all U: GL4 equivalence of quadric spaces; 33-variable 41-equation criterion, cor:symmetric-chart-isomorphism
branches.normal_forms: complete-intersection chart; no complete residual orbit normalization
branches.membership: For already AS objects, two positive linear symmetrizer spaces based at the same position and containing invertible matrices suffice; cor:two-positive-as-recognition. For arbitrary finite-Frobenius candidates, the original three-witness test applies.
branches.local_coverage_at_C0: contains a G-invariant Zariski-open neighborhood of C0 in the rank<=6 finite-Frobenius tensor scheme; smooth presentation dimension 69, thm:clifford-low-rank-local
branches.local_coverage_at_pure_anti: G-invariant open in X6, smooth presentation dimension 69; first-order quotient 12, not a 12-dimensional component
branches.local_coverage_all_CI: Open in X6 at every symmetric CI point; smooth presentation dimension 69, thm:symmetric-open-all.
branches.closure_AS_locus: Entire standard AS locus of Zsym equals this chart, thm:symmetric-closure-as-exact; ordinary GL4 orbit normal forms still unresolved.

branches.predicate: rho<=6 and canonical tensor orbit does not meet the symmetric locus
branches.coverage: alternatizability predicate and its negation; cor:linear-alternating-test
branches.nonempty_witness: commutative polynomial indexed class, alternating top tensor; proven disjoint from symmetric chart
branches.known_subcase: alternating tensor orbit: exactly the commutative polynomial indexed class

branches.predicate: canonical tensor orbit meets Lambda^4 V
branches.membership: A single negative-swap symmetrizer space containing an invertible matrix suffices for every finite-Frobenius candidate, cor:one-negative-frobenius-recognition.
branches.normal_forms: one indexed class: commutative polynomial ring
branches.relative_geometry: open orbit in X6, presentation dimension 45

branches.predicate: rho<=6 and neither symmetrizable nor alternatizable
branches.excluded_subfamilies: contains no quantum polynomial indexed class, by quantum rank formula and its two rank-six normal forms; also no member of the full polynomial-derivation Ore chart; neither uniform indexed commuting nor anticommuting Ore subclass contributes a point; entire diagonal quantum-three-generator Ore chart excluded, even up to indexed isomorphism; also avoids the proven G-invariant low-rank open neighborhood of the specified Clifford point C0; every three-factor-symmetrizable candidate with a basepoint is non-Koszul by the signed-reversal Euler obstruction, thm:partial-symmetric-basepoint-exclusion; all of Zsym outside S is excluded by thm:symmetric-closure-as-exact
branches.necessary_witness_restrictions: No invertible negative witness at any position; at most one invertibly positive partner per position. One negative witness already recognizes the polynomial indexed class; cor:one-negative-frobenius-recognition.
branches.adjacent_witness_restriction: Any adjacent positive witness forces rho6. Thus rho3/4/5 has no invertible adjacent witnesses of either sign. Negative witnesses are entirely excluded from this residual by the three-form rigidity theorem.
branches.relative_geometry: Relatively closed in the complete standard finite-Frobenius candidate locus, hence also in the AS subspace; cor:closed-low-residual. Nonemptiness on the AS locus remains open.
branches.boundary_restriction: Disjoint from Zsym on AS. Only rho five and six remain. For rho five, finite adjacent point incidence requires the two cubic-minor span dimensions to sum to at most twenty. At rho five at least two edge point correspondences must be positive-dimensional.

limits: Coverage is a partition of already regular objects, not a proof that every tensor candidate is Koszul/AS.
No claim that all integers 3..16 occur, or that a rank is a full isomorphism invariant.
Quantum rank strata and their minimal-rank subcase do not exhaust either global branch.
